name: Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper)
best_known_for: Amazon's LEO broadband constellation — ~231 production satellites in orbit as of mid-2026; ~3,236 planned
credit: Amazon Leo commercial constellation (rebranded from Project Kuiper in November 2025). First prototype launch October 2023; first 27 production satellites April 2025. Ramp-phase deployment continuing 2025-2026. FCC license requires 50% deployment by July 2026, 100% by 2029; extension request pending as of July 2026.
